ModMetaData.name: Narcotics
ModMetaData.author: Anarchist
ModMetaData.description:
Adds real-world-inspired narcotics to RimWorld using vanilla drug mechanics.
Percocet — Medical painkiller crafted at the drug lab. Strong pain relief, mild mood lift, addiction risk, and overdose if overused.
Xanax — Medical mood stabilizer crafted at the drug lab. Strong mood boost with sedation, addiction risk, and overdose if stacked.
Weed — Growable recreational crop. Harvest is ready to use (no crafting). Social high with milder overdose risk.
Cocaine — Grow coca, harvest leaves, refine powder at the drug lab. Hard stimulant with high addiction and full overdose risk.
All finished drugs can be bought from and sold to traders. Patch updates bump 0.0.1; new content bumps 0.1.0.
